section_summary.extract_value: This section outlines the contributions and implications of the present study, emphasizing that state-level increases in self-compassion (within-person) benefit young adult women's affect, body image, and eating when facing body-image threats. It contrasts these within-person findings with prior between-person research and highlights practical implications for applying self-compassion strategies on a given day.
section_summary.evidence_source: Key sentences: "Although there has been significant interest in examining the protective role that self-compassion can play when women face threats to their body image, to date, this research has occurred exclusively at the between-persons level." and "First, our findings reveal that young adult women's way of coping with body image threats does not just depend on how self-compassionate they are in general."
